QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) returns `{}` when `tokenizer_` is unset, and otherwise passes the vector through.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the backend wrapper returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It also says the inner tokenizer returns `{}` on failure. It never says the two cases return the same value, so the backend wrapper's failed-tokenization return is not tied to the no-tokenizer return.
